text: The Patriots head into a Week 6 showdown with the Jets at Gillette Stadium on Sunday, October 18 at 1 PM ET riding high after a dominant 45-17 victory over the Raiders, in which Drake Maye accounted for five touchdowns despite operating without his top receiver and both starting cornerbacks—but the win came at a cost, with left tackle Will Campbell suffering an MCL sprain in his right knee that's expected to sideline him for some game action, and running back TreVeyon Henderson dealing with a high ankle sprain that will keep him out multiple weeks. To shore up depth, the team signed RB Hassan Haskins and CB D'Shawn Jamison to the practice squad while releasing LB Jose Ramirez, moves that underscore the mounting injury concerns as New England tries to maintain momentum heading into this divisional matchup.
